title: Payment Arrangements Desk Guide — Schedule-Change Allowances by Arrangement Type
content:
For each type of Payment Arrangements the allowances below fix how many due-date changes, restructures of the installment amount and count, and installment deferrals are allowed in any rolling 12 months, how far one due-date change may move the next due date, and how many installments must already be paid before a restructure or a deferral.

## Allowance table

| Arrangement type | Due-date changes per 12 months | Largest shift of one due-date change (calendar days) | Restructures per 12 months | Installments paid before a restructure | Deferrals per 12 months | Installments paid before a deferral |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Promise-to-Pay Arrangement | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | 1 | 10 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Standard Installment Plan | 2 | 15 | 1 | 3 | 1 | 3 |
| Extended Installment Plan | 2 | 15 | 1 | 3 | 1 | 3 |
| Long-Term Installment Plan | 3 | 15 | 2 | 6 | 2 | 6 |
| Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan | 3 | 20 | 2 | 3 | 2 | 3 |

## Questions the table answers

**Does the Promise-to-Pay Arrangement allow any schedule change of these kinds?**
No. Its due-date, restructure and deferral allowances all read 0.

**Which types allow a restructure or a deferral at all?**
The Standard, Extended and Long-Term Installment Plans and the Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan; the Promise-to-Pay Arrangement and the Short-Term Installment Plan read 0 for both.

**How far can one due-date change move a due date on a Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan?**
No more than 20 calendar days; on the Standard, Extended and Long-Term Installment Plans no more than 15, and on the Short-Term Installment Plan no more than 10.

**How many installments must a Long-Term Installment Plan have paid before a restructure?**
6; the Standard and Extended Installment Plans and the Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan read 3.
